analysis.title: Warren, 96, Is Laughing Again
key_insights: Market leadership is shifting from growth and momentum toward quality, even though the major indices remain near all-time highs.
Berkshire Hathaway (the 'king of quality' in the note) is up 5% in five days, and the five-year chart shows the outperformance is not new.
GS trading desk: its sector, industry and factor neutral Quality Pair Index (GSP1QUAL) is up 20% over the last 3 months to a 12-month high on about 13% realized vol.
Earnings growth is expected to decelerate across both AI and non-AI sectors over the next 12 months, which the note says could favor quality.
Higher rates being priced in are an additional tailwind for the quality trade.
Quality is behaving like an anti-AI trade, with a strong negative correlation to AI, momentum and high-beta exposure.
Quality has tended to outperform when earnings revisions roll over (YoY net change in the YoY % change of SPX NTM EPS estimates).
Positioning in momentum and beta remains elevated (momentum at the 78th percentile over five years, beta at the 81st), so a momentum and beta unwind could be more painful.
Long quality versus short momentum is up 55% in 2026, and the note says the longer-term chart suggests room for more upside if this is the start of a structural rotation.
